responsibility: This module implements the Rust front end’s High-level Intermediate Representation layer and the AST-to-HIR lowering pass that constructs it. Its `rust-ast-lower*` files form the crate-level lowering pipeline, translating parsed Rust AST items, impl and trait members, extern declarations, expressions, block forms, statements, patterns, types, generic parameters, bounds, paths, visibility, and special cases such as enum variants and format arguments into HIR nodes while assigning mappings, ids, source locations, attributes, and parent-child relationships. Its `tree/` subdirectory defines the HIR object model itself—core node bases plus concrete item, expression, statement, pattern, path, type, generic-parameter, bound, visibility, and attribute classes—together with cloning, stringification, and visitor support for later semantic passes. The module also includes default HIR traversal and dump utilities, making it the central representation-building and structural traversal subsystem that bridges the Rust parser and subsequent analysis stages.
